provenance.source_validation: Frozen completion/source metadata, source file sizes/mtimes stable during scan, and frozen signal source hashes; no raw waveform revalidation

definitions.patient_counts: Distinct patients with at least one included window; patient counts in disjoint window categories can overlap and must not be summed.
definitions.events: Distinct ICU first-treatment events with at least one positive prediction window at the named stage, not sensitivity or prediction success.
definitions.current_epoch_planned: Exact hourly endpoint exists in completed epoch cache; metadata overlap caused planning, not necessarily available lead II or decodable ECG.
definitions.current_decoded_ok_or_partial: Decoder returned ok or partial; incomplete/nonfinite signal may still fail engineering screening.
definitions.history: Current and preceding five exact hourly five-minute samples. Three/six samples do not mean three/six continuous ECG hours. History-only stages do not necessarily have accepted current RR.
definitions.hours: Sum of each hourly landmark's actual untreated observation duration, including partial final intervals. Binary-evaluable hours exclude censored rows.
definitions.reasons: Reason/error counts are nonexclusive and can exceed rejected windows; decode errors include warnings even if another source decoded successfully.
definitions.age: Descriptive, unadjusted window/stay composition. Patients may have multiple ICU stays and age bands; no causal selection-bias or significance claim.
definitions.ceiling: Planned/decodable stages are optimistic ceilings under unchanged data and hourly selection, not forecasts of recoverable or clinically valid HRV.
definitions.validity: Engineering acceptance is not adjudicated timing accuracy, sinus rhythm, normal NN qualification, or clinical HRV validity.
